steps.content: [First-person perspective of Bagel] [Hiding in a dark bathroom/storage room] [2 a.m.]

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: ... I'm Bagel. I'm new to the Game 5732 development team at ▌▌▌▌. If anyone hears this message, please pass it on... I don't know who to tell.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: Recently, the project has been experiencing severe issues. I've been on edge and worried about my colleague Rise, so I came back to see what was happening.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: ...But I discovered something even more alarming... Listen...

steps.speaker: Artist Duck
steps.content: Got it, I will fix it immediately... Got it, I will fix it immediately... Got it, I will fix it immediately...

steps.speaker: Code Duck
steps.content: 97%, 98%, 99%... 99.3... 99.6... Ahhh, why did the package fail again, ahhh!

steps.speaker: Rock Duck
steps.content: ...Ahhh... Quack... Ahhh...

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: Hear that? My bosses are making weird noises in the conference room. I took a peek, and all six of them look possessed. Their faces are twisted and terrifying.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: They've been asleep for nine hours. I know I should call the police... but my phone has no signal, and I don't have the courage to go out now... Eek!!
Bang!!!
(The door opens. White screen. Silhouette of boss appears.)

steps.speaker: Boss Duck
steps.content: Huff... You... You...

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: ...Sir? I didn't mean to hide here. I'm an intern. My name is...

steps.speaker: Boss Duck
steps.content: Are you... the mole...? Are you... Ah?!!

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: Ahhh, help!!!
(Sound of being hit)

steps.speaker: Boss Duck
steps.content: Quack...?!
(The boss disappears. Clatter of fight off-screen)

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: ...I'm still alive... What happened? Where's the boss?
Bagel sneaks out.
An even more baffling scene greets her. In the empty office, the tables and chairs are overturned, engulfed in a sea of fire under the blaring smoke alarm.
At this moment, the previously signal-less phone suddenly vibrates.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: A phone notification... Why??
Beep... New ▌message notification.

steps.speaker: RiSe
steps.content: Why are you still there? Go now!
It's a message from an unfamiliar account, but when opened, it shows a series of colorful, flashing characters in the chat history. Scrolling up...

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content: ...Rise?
